description: This Java source file defines the CCPaymentServices class, which provides methods for handling various payment operations (authorization, capture, refund, etc.) with the ClearCommerce payment gateway within the OFBiz framework. It includes request building, sending, and response processing logic, along with utility methods and exception handling.

classes.name: CCPaymentServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for processing various payment transactions with ClearCommerce, including authorization, capture, refund, reauthorization, report, and utility functions for request/response handling.

classes.name: ClearCommerceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to ClearCommerce communication.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs authorization of a credit card transaction with ClearCommerce, builds request, sends it, and processes response.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Performs credit (refund) transaction with ClearCommerce, handling request creation, sending, and response processing.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: ccReleaseNoop
methods.description: Simulates a release operation without actual processing, returning success with existing auth transaction data.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured transaction.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Re-authorizes a transaction, typically for extended authorization.

methods.name: ccReport
methods.description: Requests a report from ClearCommerce for a specific order.

methods.name: processAuthResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the XML response from an authorization request.

methods.name: processCreditResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the XML response from a credit (refund) request.

methods.name: processCaptureResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the response from a capture request.

methods.name: processReleaseResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the response from a release (void) request.

methods.name: processRefundResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the response from a refund request.

methods.name: processReAuthResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the response from a re-authorization request.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Extracts message list with severity from the response XML document.

methods.name: getMessageListMaxSev
methods.description: Determines the maximum severity level among messages in the response XML.

methods.name: getReferenceNum
methods.description: Retrieves the reference number from the response XML document.

methods.name: buildPrimaryTxRequest
methods.description: Constructs an XML document for primary transaction requests (auth, credit, capture, etc.).

methods.name: buildSecondaryTxRequest
methods.description: Constructs an XML document for secondary transaction requests (void, refund, reauth).

methods.name: appendPaymentMechNode
methods.description: Adds payment method details (credit card info) to the XML request.

methods.name: appendAddressNode
methods.description: Adds address details to the XML request.

methods.name: appendTransactionNode
methods.description: Adds transaction details (type, amount, currency) to the XML request.

methods.name: createRequestDocument
methods.description: Creates the base XML document structure for requests.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Serializes XML request, sends it via HTTP, and parses the response XML.
